data.name: Apoorva
data.gender_notes: Apoorva is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Apoorva means new, fresh, and unparalleled. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'apoorva' which means 'unseen, unheard, unprecedented'. In Hindu mythology, Apoorva is a name given to the goddess of prosperity and good fortune, Lakshmi, who is believed to bring new beginnings and fresh opportunities. The name Apoorva carries the meaning “New, Fresh” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Apoorva usually hope their child will grow to embody new, fresh and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the freshness and purity of new beginnings.
data.etymology: Apoorva belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “New, Fresh.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Apoorva total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
